$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsinh}⁡x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}}.

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}}\,\text{d}x=\sqrt{2}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}}\,\text{d}x=\sqrt{2}\operatorname{arsinh}⁡x+C.\end{aligned}
$$
